passages.transcript:
N: Number 38.
W: When does the new fiscal year begin?
N: (A) In the finance department.
N: (B) On the first of July.
N: (C) Ms. Dubois is in charge.

N: Number 39.
M: Where should I leave the signed contracts?
N: (A) Yesterday afternoon.
N: (B) On the desk by the window.
N: (C) Three copies, please.

N: Number 40.
W: Who is going to present the sales figures?
N: (A) They increased by ten percent.
N: (B) In the main conference room.
N: (C) Mr. Yoon volunteered.

N: Number 41.
M: Why was the workshop cancelled?
N: (A) In Room 204.
N: (B) Not enough people signed up.
N: (C) On Thursday morning.

N: Number 42.
W: How can I get to the airport from the hotel?
N: (A) Yes, it was a long flight.
N: (B) About two hundred dollars.
N: (C) There's a shuttle every half hour.

N: Number 43.
M: Which candidate did the committee choose?
N: (A) The one from the Seattle office.
N: (B) About thirty minutes.
N: (C) Next Monday at nine.

N: Number 44.
W: What's the deadline for the grant application?
N: (A) The grant office is closed.
N: (B) A hundred and fifty pages.
N: (C) It was extended until the twentieth.

N: Number 45.
M: How long will the software update take?
N: (A) On the main server.
N: (B) The IT department did it.
N: (C) Less than an hour.

N: Number 46.
W: Where did you buy that laptop bag?
N: (A) It's very comfortable.
N: (B) My sister gave it to me.
N: (C) Last winter, I think.

N: Number 47.
M: Who should I send the receipts to?
N: (A) Whoever is at the front desk.
N: (B) It costs fifty dollars.
N: (C) In the top drawer.

N: Number 48.
W: Did you finish the quarterly report?
N: (A) The reporter was late.
N: (B) Almost, I just need to add the charts.
N: (C) In the afternoon, I guess.

N: Number 49.
M: Is the cafeteria open on weekends?
N: (A) No, only on weekdays.
N: (B) Café au lait, please.
N: (C) It has a lot of choices.

N: Number 50.
W: Have you booked the conference room for Friday?
N: (A) Yes, from two to four.
N: (B) The room was very cold.
N: (C) In the Friday edition.

N: Number 51.
M: Can you work late tomorrow?
N: (A) I have a dentist appointment at five.
N: (B) It's a late model.
N: (C) Yes, I took them to work.

N: Number 52.
W: Did the client approve the budget?
N: (A) It's a large budget.
N: (B) Not yet; they're meeting this afternoon.
N: (C) Yes, he has a client.

N: Number 53.
M: Are you attending the safety training?
N: (A) At eleven o'clock.
N: (B) It is a very safe city.
N: (C) I already took it last month.

N: Number 54.
W: Would you like some help carrying those boxes?
N: (A) They are very heavy.
N: (B) Thanks, that would be great.
N: (C) It's in the box.

N: Number 55.
M: Could you send me the agenda before the meeting?
N: (A) At the end of the month.
N: (B) It's on the third floor.
N: (C) Sure, I'll email it now.

N: Number 56.
W: Why don't we move the meeting to Thursday?
N: (A) Thursday works for me.
N: (B) The meeting room is large.
N: (C) Because it was cancelled.

N: Number 57.
M: I'd recommend ordering the supplies today.
N: (A) Good idea; I'll place the order.
N: (B) The suppliers are in Ohio.
N: (C) It was ordered yesterday.

N: Number 58.
W: The printer is out of paper again.
N: (A) I'll bring some from the supply room.
N: (B) A paper on printing.
N: (C) He prints very fast.

N: Number 59.
M: Who approved the new vacation schedule?
N: (A) Two weeks in August.
N: (B) I haven't seen the final version.
N: (C) In the break room.

N: Number 60.
W: Do you know when the shipment arrives?
N: (A) Because it was heavy.
N: (B) Yes, it was a nice ship.
N: (C) You should ask the warehouse.

N: Number 61.
M: Is the new hire working out well?
N: (A) She starts at nine.
N: (B) Out of the building.
N: (C) It's a bit early to say.

N: Number 62.
W: Where's the best place to have the farewell lunch?
N: (A) How many people are coming?
N: (B) About noon.
N: (C) It's a lovely farewell.
